paper.title: Auto-G-Computation of Causal Effects on a Network
paper.venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association

paper_reference.paper_question: 网络干扰下，如何利用网络联合分布和图结构计算干预效应？
paper_reference.target: 指定干预下的网络结果分布或平均结果。
paper_reference.source_location: Tchetgen Tchetgen, Fulcher & Shpitser (2021), Auto-G; project literature card and route note only.
paper_reference.formula: Auto-G computation over the network joint law and a declared chain-graph decomposition; not reproduced in this case package.
conditions: No substitution by independent-unit or existing R1/R2/R3 POINT methods.
what_paper_supports: Network dependence must be modeled explicitly.
Auto-G is a dedicated network identification/estimation route.
what_paper_does_not_support: It does not mean the current software has an Auto-G backend.
It does not make the four-node synthetic case a paper replication.
It does not justify routing the case to R1/R2/R3.

missing_condition.reason: No Auto-G backend; additionally only finite sample is provided.

changed_target.reason: No Auto-G backend; changing to a fixed policy mean does not create support.

actual_run.note: No Auto-G business run was attempted because there is no Auto-G reader/backend.

notes: Holdout candidate. Paper route is recorded separately from software status. UNSUPPORTED is not non-identification.
